modification_description: The synthesis should explicitly require closing real-world legal gaps by mandating: (1) signed emergency medical power of attorney and HIPAA-authorized contacts, (2) a formal court-filed custody/parenting plan and mechanisms like second-parent adoption where applicable, (3) comprehensive estate planning including wills, guardianship nominations, beneficiary designations, and trusts, and (4) jurisdiction-specific confirmation by a family-law attorney that the legal framework actually delivers the protections marriage would automatically provide.
